payload.text: hv, 2026-09-20, on devbin-vc's pre-notice of the devbin 0.1.2 fleet sweep, in hv's words: "Yes, get 2.10 out first, then we can update Devbin post that." So Utilz ships 2.10.0 first, and the sweep of the vendored devbin follows the tag. vc has told devbin-vc, and will tell it the result of CI run 35507688287, which decides ST0021's last criterion. Nothing of devbin is taken by hand at Utilz in the meantime, and ST0007 WP-08, where Utilz adopts devbin's release core, stays after the sweep.
